tasks.summary: The fix correctly makes pinnedTriple's story document conditional only on the `historical` flag, matching the documented bug: a standalone Story with a Plan pins only {lld, plan} at admission (route.plan && !route.def → requiredDocumentRoles returns ['lld','plan']), but publish/resume/second-start re-read the stored attempt via pinnedTriple (no route, no `derived` since `derived` is only set for Plan-less routes) and previously hard-required `storyRef`, so re-reads of such a Story always failed admission validation (no CR record written). Now `requireReview(lldRef && planRef && (storyRef || historical), ...)` admits the historical re-read without story while still requiring all three (or refusing) for a fresh, non-historical start. The story-specific checks (storyId/epicHash/role match) are now skipped via `if (docs.story)` rather than unconditionally dereferencing possibly-absent data, and the epicHash/role-match loop (`Object.entries(docs)`) already only iterates present keys so it naturally skips the omitted story entry.

testCoverage.explanation: Both new tests exercise exactly the fixed code path: route-documents.test.ts's new test prepares a stored {lld, plan} packet with `historical=true` (no route), confirms it produces the same tasks/documents as the at-start routed call, confirms the legacy {story, lld, plan} triple still re-reads fine, and confirms a fresh (non-historical) {lld, plan} packet with no route is still refused — directly covering the fix's three stated guarantees (stored re-read succeeds without story, legacy triple still works, start-side strictness unchanged). The companion refusal test confirms a stored re-read still requires lld and plan, and still enforces the LLD-belongs-to-another-story check with story absent. publication.test.ts's new test deletes `documents.story` from a stored checkpoint (built from the standard fixture, which has no `derived` header since its route has a Plan) and confirms `publishTaskCheckpoint` (which calls `prepareReviewPacket(..., historical=true, undefined, header.derived)`) now succeeds end-to-end, reproducing the originally reported defect (#100) at the publication layer, not just the packet-preparation unit. I traced the call sites (admission.ts:37, publication.ts:25) to confirm `derived` is genuinely undefined for a Plan-bearing route, so these re-reads do fall through to `pinnedTriple` with `historical=true` as the tests assume. I ran both test files plus the full task-review suite (124/125 passing) and `tsc --noEmit` (clean); the one unrelated failure (history.test.ts, a coordinator call-count assertion) touches a file untouched by this change and predates it.

advice: Optional execution: ran `npx tsx --test src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/route-documents.test.ts src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/publication.test.ts` (14/14 pass), the full `src/workflow/code-review/task-review/**/*.test.ts` sweep (124/125 pass, one unrelated pre-existing failure in history.test.ts touching coordinator call-counting, a file this change did not modify), and `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` (clean) to corroborate the builder-reported results.

The unrelated history.test.ts failure ('all-reuse attempts and invalid attribution preserve route parity without extra task calls', calls 3 !== 1) is outside this Task's changed files and should be filed/tracked separately rather than blocking this fix.

tasks.summary: pinnedTriple now takes the story document as optional only when historical=true (stored re-reads: publication, admission resume, admission start-attempt validation of prior entries); start-side admission still always requires story+lld+plan unless a route is present. Traced both call sites (publication.ts:25, admission.ts:37) that pass historical=true and confirmed the standalone Story+Plan scenario (no derived stored, since derived is only set for no-Plan routes) falls through to pinnedTriple, exactly the path the fix targets. The two added tests exercise both the relaxed re-read and the still-strict start path, and both passed under current checkout.

testCoverage.explanation: Ran both new test files (route-documents.test.ts, publication.test.ts) against the current checkout: all 14 tests pass, including the two acceptance tests for the fix. Inspected test bodies: the route-documents test directly compares a historical re-read (story omitted) against the at-start routed admission and asserts identical tasks/documents, and separately confirms the legacy triple and the non-historical (start) path still require story+lld+plan. The publication test deletes the story document from a stored checkpoint's submitted documents and asserts publication still completes. Traced the code path (pinnedTriple, prepareReviewPacket, publication.ts, admission.ts) to confirm the historical flag is wired through exactly the call sites relevant to stored re-reads (publish, resume, and admission's replay of prior attempts), and that fresh starts (historical=false, no route) are unaffected. Did not revert-and-retest packet.ts against the parent commit due to sandbox file-write restrictions outside normal review scope; relying on builder-reported pre-fix failure plus code-level trace for that specific claim.

advice: Optional execution: did not revert packet.ts to the parent commit and rerun the new tests to directly observe a pre-fix failure (sandbox approval for writing outside the tracked file path was not pursued); relied on builder-reported execution details plus a manual code trace confirming the historical-only relaxation instead.
